text: Trace a generated setting to its owner before altering a DEFINE. RNP PACKAGE_STRING comes from preprocessing config.h.in with RNP_VERSION_FULL. Mutating rnp_defines after that cannot change the generated identity. Commit 266 passes the configured backend to rnp_generated.py and build generation instead. Keep help and allowed backend handling valid in configure. The current generator also receives a backend version, a newer extension. Source inspected; no configure or build run.
title: RNP backend identity belongs to the generated version path
